sequoia-summer-health:ashbyhq:c6147c53-5.title: Pediatric Nurse Practitioner
sequoia-summer-health:ashbyhq:c6147c53-5.description: We're looking for a Nurse Practitioner who believes longevity starts in childhood. Someone who wants to spend their days reading labs carefully, talking with families thoughtfully, and helping kids build a healthier baseline for the next eighty years. THE ROLE Compensation: ~$75/hour rate Location: Virtual/Remote Role Type: Part-time, 20-30 hours/week Grow by Summer Health is a comprehensive blood panel for ages 9–18 — 74 biomarkers across five systems, drawn at a lab near home and read by a pediatric clinician with the time to actually read them. As a Nurse Practitioner on the Grow clinical team, you'll be the person reading those panels. You'll learn our protocols inside and out, interpret results against pediatric-specific reference ranges, flag what matters, and meet families on video to walk them through what their child's biomarkers say about energy, growth, mood, metabolic health, and long-term risk. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Regardless of background, the clinicians we bring onto the Grow team share a few things in common: - 🧬 A believer that longevity starts in childhood. You think the markers we set in motion at 12 shape who someone is at 50, and you're excited to work in the window where it matters most. - 📊 A careful reader of labs. You don't just look for red flags; you look for trends, ratios, and the borderline values that a busy practice would skim past. You enjoy the puzzle. - 📚 A steward of science. You stay current with pediatric biomarker research, reference range debates, and the evolving evidence on screening, you're the person who says "actually, the optimal range for that shifted." - 🌐 A true believer that technology can democratize healthcare. You believe digital-first care, done right, can bring world-class medicine to every family, regardless of zip code or income. - ❤️ A clear, compassionate communicator. You can explain ferritin to a worried mom and lipid subfractions to a curious dad without losing either of them. Anxious parents leave your calls calmer than they came in. - 🔬 A believer in prevention and precision. You think more personalized information and more time with patients leads to better outcomes, and you're excited by what's possible when we give families the tools to be proactive, not just reactive WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Master the Grow protocols. Upskill on our 74-biomarker panel, pediatric-specific reference ranges, and our clinical decision frameworks during a structured onboarding period — and stay sharp as the protocols evolve - Read every panel carefully. Review full biomarker results across nutrients, metabolic, cardiovascular, blood/immune, and thyroid systems. Flag what matters, contextualize what doesn't, and document your reasoning clearly - Sit with families. Lead 30-minute video walkthroughs where you go through every value, every flag, and exactly what to do next - Write the follow-up plan. Translate the panel into a clear, written plan: diet shifts, targeted supplements, lifestyle changes, recheck timing, or referral when needed - Sharpen the practice. Bring patterns you see across panels back to the clinical team. Help refine protocols, reference ranges, and family-facing language as we learn QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED - Master's or Doctoral degree from an accredited Nurse Practitioner program - National certification as a CPNP-PC (Certified Pediatric Nurse Practitioner – Primary Care) or FNP-BC/FNP-C with substantial pediatric experience - Active, unrestricted RN and APRN licensure, with willingness to obtain additional state licenses as needed for our nationwide patient base - Demonstrated clinical experience interpreting pediatric lab results and communicating findings to families - Comfort with telehealth and a fully remote, video-based practice - Highly responsive, proactive, and organized IDEAL - Background or strong interest in preventative, functional, or longevity-oriented medicine - Fami

usv-pluralis-research:ashbyhq:481f9f1b-b.description: Pluralis Research https://pluralis.ai/ works on Protocol Learning https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.07890— training large models in a fully decentralised way on small consumer-grade devices connected via the internet. Despite being dismissed as infeasible, we have made significant advances on this problem https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.01260, most recently training an 8B llama model from scratch with devices in physically different regions. While many of the core research problems have been solved, Protocol Learning unlocks a series of new challenges. If you want your work to shape the future of truly open innovation in the large model regime, join us. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Publish in Tier-1 Venues: At the core of Protocol Learning are hard research problems. There are foundational papers up for grabs. Solve these problems, and publish. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Research Excellence: PhD in Machine Learning with publications in top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR). - Distributed ML Experience: Exposure to distributed training, or federated learning. - Implementation Skills: Strong programming abilities in PyTorch, with experience training models across multiple devices. - Bonus: Experience with large language models, post training, RL etc. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS - Equity-Heavy Package: We offer significant ownership for key technical contributors in addition to high base salary. - Visa Sponsorship: Optional full visa sponsorship and relocation support to either US or Australia. - Remote-First Culture: Flexible work environment with team members distributed globally. - Cutting-Edge Domain: Work at the intersection of AI and distributed systems, tackling some of the most challenging research problems in what is about to be one of the largest intersections of two previously non-overlapping fields ever. FYI’S - We only hire in Australia and the United States. Visa sponsorship is limited to these countries. - Applicants must have professional-level English proficiency (written and spoken). - Pluralis is a remote team across Australia and the US. You’ll need to be comfortable working across timezones and collaborating with a diverse, distributed group. - Recruiters: we aren’t looking for agency support at this time. We’ll reach out if we need help. We are backed by Union Square Ventures https://www.usv.com/ and are a world-class, deeply technical team of ML researchers. We view the world as a better place if we are able to implement what we are attempting, and Protocol Learning as the way to prevent corporations monopolising model development, access and release, and achieving massive economic capture. If this resonates, please apply.

usv-stedi:ashbyhq:566f3d59-ec20-4167-89a.description: WE'RE BUILDING A NEW HEALTHCARE CLEARINGHOUSE Stedi is building the first new healthcare clearinghouse in decades. In the healthcare sector, the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA) requires that all insurance payers exchange transactions such as claims, eligibility checks, prior authorizations, and remittances using a standardized EDI format called X12 HIPAA. Clearinghouses process the majority of these transactions, offering consolidated connectivity to carriers and providers. Until Stedi, the space was occupied entirely by a small group of legacy players, built on outdated, often pre-internet technology. Stedi is the world's only programmable healthcare clearinghouse. By offering modern API interfaces alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp https://ramp.com/velocity/top-saas-vendors-on-ramp-march-2026 as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors. We have lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company’s infrastructure; passion for automation and eliminating toil; $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack’s interview with First Round Capital https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IO6sR-i5rSs. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Stedi is the world's only programmable healthcare clearinghouse. By offering a modern API interface for running eligibility checks, processing claims, and ingesting ERAs, healthcare technology businesses can exchange transactions with payers without dealing with the EDI protocol or carrier-specific connectivity. As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Frontend Engineer to bring the Stedi vision to life. You'll work closely with other engineers, designers, and product managers to execute on a broad range of projects – from building foundational features in our web product to testing for reliability and consistency throughout. HOW WE BUILD - Our backend teams use AWS exclusively for all customer-facing backend infrastructure. We use tools like GitHub, Stripe, and PagerDuty, but all the application work happens on AWS. - All exposed API endpoints are available to the frontend via strongly-typed SDK clients. - Our frontend applications are built using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, based on designs provided by our design team in Figma. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Collaborate with design, product and backend engineering to build web interfaces that power our products and features. - Develop reusable, responsive, accessible components using scalable, semantic React components. - Contribute to our design language system. - Contribute to a culture of engineering excellence and rigor through both coding and writing, as well as high-quality, effective communication WHO YOU ARE - 4+ years of relevant web front-end development experience at a tech-forward software company. - Solid understanding of modern frontend technology stack (React, UI testing, CSS-in-JS, Server-side rendering). - Advanced knowledge in JavaScript/TypeScript. - Experience setting up and maintaining build, test, and deployment tools in production environments. - Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between design, product, and engineering. - An exceptional contributor who creates and executes their own work. - Highly curious; not satisfied with getting something to work, you want to understand why it works and how to make it high-quality. - Philosophical alignment with the Stedi Standards https://www.stedi.com/careers. We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team. Please note: - All official communicati
